newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Del Monte Foods sinks to new year low.
newsitem.headline: Del Monte Foods sinks to new year low.

text.p: South Africa's Del Monte Royal Foods Ltd sank to a fresh year low on Wednesday as the market continued to digest a recent profit warning, dealers said.
The firm lost 20 cents to 240 cents, while Del Monte Holdings Ltd also hit a new year low of 220 cents, down 10 cents on the day. Del Monte Corp Ltd gained four cents to 216 cents.
"The group has been on a downward track since the profit warning," one dealer said.

The firm announced last week that it is to embark on a restructuring process that will include one-off charges and changes to its accounting policy that will cut its profit for the current year to below that of last year.
For the year to November 30, Del Monte posted headline earnings per share of 50.1 cents from 42.2 cents and a dividend of 19.0 cents from 16 cents.
Analysts expect the firm to shift its focus away from canned fruit and more towards fruit juices in the developed world where a healthy eating trend is boosting juice sales.
